about_the_game:
Genre : Social deduction game (Wargame)

Number of players : 4~12

[Story]

A house was built in a forest, where a spirit called “Fluffy” lived.

However, there were some people who tried to take away the house of “Fluffy”.

[Rules]

The players are divided into two camps, “Fluffy” and “Lumpy,” and each camp aims for its own victory.

Fluffy” wins by expelling all Lumpies, and ‘Lumpy’ attacks Fluffy so that the number of Fluffy's is equal to the number of Lumpies.

At night, a player selects one “action card” in his/her possession. In the morning, players discuss with each other and decide who to expel.

[Features]

{Three-story dwellings}

Players are randomly assigned a room at the beginning of the game.

A ladder may be necessary to get to someone's room. The position of the ladder changes randomly every night.

{More than 17 different action cards}

There are multiple options to choose from for the nightly action.

(Examples of Action Cards)

・Ladder switch

Removes a ladder from the residence, making it impossible to move from one floor to another.

・Mushroom Trap

The player who comes close to the trap will have mushrooms growing out of his/her head the next morning.

{Detailed rule settings}

The following rules can be edited.

Meeting time/Time to choose the night's action /Kill on the first night/Number of cards in possession/The appearance of each action card

{Other functions}

Chat function.

Cute poses for reactions in the lobby and during meetings.

Door design and character color can be changed.

[Courtesy]
